headline: PM heads to New York Monday for first UNGA address
summary: The Prime Minister is set to travel to the United States for a busy schedule including his first address to the UN General Assembly.
details: The Prime Minister is scheduled to depart for New York on Monday to attend the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA).
This visit marks his first address to the UNGA, where he is expected to present Bangladesh's perspectives on global issues.
The Prime Minister's itinerary in New York is described as busy, involving multiple high-level meetings and diplomatic engagements.
The visit is seen as a critical opportunity to strengthen international relations and discuss key national and global priorities.
caption:
The Prime Minister is heading to New York this Monday for his first-ever UNGA address.

The Prime Minister is scheduled to depart for New York on Monday to attend the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA).

This visit marks his first address to the UNGA, where he is expected to present Bangladesh's perspectives on global issues.

The Prime Minister's itinerary in New York is described as busy, involving multiple high-level meetings and diplomatic engagements.

The visit is seen as a critical opportunity to strengthen international relations and discuss key national and global priorities.

headline: Over 60,000 cases: Two more die as dengue cases rise
summary: Total dengue cases in Bangladesh have crossed 60,000, with the death toll reaching 178 as 1,232 new cases were recorded in 24 hours.
details: Two more dengue patients died and 1,232 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today.
With these latest additions, the total number of dengue cases has risen to 60,379, while the overall death toll has reached 178.
Currently, 4,133 dengue patients are receiving treatment at various hospitals across the country.
caption:
Dengue cases in Bangladesh have officially crossed 60,000. Two more lives were lost in just 24 hours.

Two more dengue patients died and 1,232 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today.

With these latest additions, the total number of dengue cases has risen to 60,379, while the overall death toll has reached 178.

Currently, 4,133 dengue patients are receiving treatment at various hospitals across the country.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star
